pass_1.finding: Independently read all tagged F/R adapter pairs and untagged pair, including 5′-phosphate R and terminal phosphorothioate F; matched-strand annealing; AluI digestion, dA tailing and bead-bound ligation. pass_2.locations: Original 2015 Nature Protocols facsimile, Table 1 at ResearchGate HTML lines 891-945; Materials adapter annealing lines 980-1015; Procedure steps 54-70 at lines 1396-1523; library barcode discussion lines 400-424 and step 61 lines 1436-1463
pass_2.finding: Read the full original article facsimile. Table 1 prints the same 12 3-bp tagged F/R adapter pairs plus untagged pair, with terminal phosphorothioate on F and 5-prime phosphate on R. Materials anneals matched F/R strands; Procedure A-tails AluI fragments, ligates selected adapter on beads, and then amplifies. Step 61 says inline tag occupies first three bases of each read followed by TCT; no separate index read is specified. This supports existing schematic scope, but the earlier pass_1 only noted a citation and did not independently read the article.
